source_text: Nucleosome occupancy is an explicit local state when this option is enabled. Eviction can expose a TF site, clears marks at that site, and changes the configured local persistence multiplier. Bound writers and recruited coactivators can alter marks; spreading follows three-dimensional chromatin contacts. Mark-dependent chromatin attraction is a separate interaction from a protein's mark preference. The learning example lets you compare occupied and vacant capture hazards and persistence values. Those numerical relationships explain a hypothesis; the illustration is not an equilibrium polymer calculation.
